verses.original: שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ וְרִ֘יבָ֤ה רִיבִ֗י מִגּ֥וֹי לֹא־ חָסִ֑יד מֵ֤אִישׁ־ מִרְמָ֖ה וְעַוְלָ֣ה תְפַלְּטֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: šā·p̄ə·ṭê·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·rî·ḇāh rî·ḇî mig·gō·w lō- ḥā·sîḏ mê·’îš- mir·māh wə·‘aw·lāh ṯə·p̄al·lə·ṭê·nî
verses.literal: Vindicate me O God and plead my case against an ungodly . . . nation deliver me from deceitful and unjust men
verses.literalPt: FAZE-ME justiça, ó Deus, e pleiteia a minha causa contra a nação ímpia. Livra-me do homem fraudulento e injusto.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֤ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י מָֽעוּזִּי֮ לָמָ֪ה זְנַ֫חְתָּ֥נִי לָֽמָּה־ קֹדֵ֥ר אֶתְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּלַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hê mā·‘ūz·zî lā·māh zə·naḥ·tā·nî lām·māh- qō·ḏêr ’eṯ·hal·lêḵ bə·la·ḥaṣ ’ō·w·yêḇ
verses.literal: For You are the God of my refuge Why have You rejected me Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression
verses.literalPt: Pois tu és o Deus da minha fortaleza; por que me rejeitas? Por que ando lamentando por causa da opressão do inimigo?

verses.original: שְׁלַח־ אוֹרְךָ֣ וַ֭אֲמִתְּךָ הֵ֣מָּה יַנְח֑וּנִי יְבִיא֥וּנִי אֶל־ הַֽר־ קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ וְאֶל־ מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·laḥ- ’ō·wr·ḵā wa·’ă·mit·tə·ḵā hêm·māh yan·ḥū·nî yə·ḇî·’ū·nî ’el- har- qāḏ·šə·ḵā wə·’el- miš·kə·nō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Send out Your light and Your truth let them lead me Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to the place where You dwell
verses.literalPt: Envia a tua luz e a tua verdade, para que me guiem e me levem ao teu santo monte, e aos teus tabernáculos.

verses.original: וְאָב֤וֹאָה׀ אֶל־ מִזְבַּ֬ח אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל־ אֵל֮ שִׂמְחַ֪ת גִּ֫ילִ֥י וְאוֹדְךָ֥ בְכִנּ֗וֹר אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḇō·w·’āh ’el- miz·baḥ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- ’êl śim·ḥaṯ gî·lî wə·’ō·wḏ·ḵā ḇə·ḵin·nō·wr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: Then I will go to the altar of God to God my greatest joy . . . I will praise You with the harp O God my God
verses.literalPt: Então irei ao altar de Deus, a Deus, que é a minha grande alegria, e com harpa te louvarei, ó Deus, Deus meu.

verses.original: מַה־ תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י׀ נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה־ תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי־ ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵֽאלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mah- tiš·tō·w·ḥă·ḥî nap̄·šî ū·mah- te·hĕ·mî ‘ā·lāy hō·w·ḥî·lî lê·lō·hîm kî- ‘ō·wḏ ’ō·w·ḏen·nū yə·šū·‘ōṯ pā·nay wê·lō·hāy
verses.literal: Why are you downcast O my soul Why the unease within me Put your hope in God for I will yet praise Him my Savior . . . and my God
verses.literalPt: Por que estás abatida, ó minha alma? E por que te perturbas dentro de mim? Espera em Deus, pois ainda o louvarei, o qual é a salvação da minha face e Deus meu.
